_doc: The greybox's S1 (StoryLayer, WorldRegion r1_grey): the reach stopped. WorldRiver's still reach applies (the river block's reaches, scale 0 in S1) and the reach is cordoned (plan section 2, 'The Silence in play': soldiers and clan watchers turn people back; what touching the water does stays unanswered). cordon: read by ThuyVanCordon. ropes: a rope line across the corridor at each end of the reach, posts every post_m; watchers: people standing at the ropes facing out (river_z, river_d: their place by the river, the d m along x from its centre); hold: how far either side of the river's centre the corridor runs; lines: what a watcher says to someone who comes up to the rope (plain words, nothing explained).
label: The reach still

lines: No one goes past the rope.
